verdict.rationale: a-Shell's own site says it is entirely open source under the FreeBSD license. Several evidence items come from its public GitHub repository (holzschu/a-shell), which shows the source is readable. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the license file in the repository itself.

citations.quote: a-Shell is entirely OpenSource, and released under the FreeBSD license.
